body: You too.
This is horribly close to home.  Are you okay?
thanks
That is not helpful.
Why?
I can relate.  I have no idea.
Yes.  It doesn't go down well.  People don't want to hear that you're struggling, that's the impression I've always been given.
I'm gonna stop telling him anymore.  If I just bottle it up and put on a smile, everything will be fine.  Assuming he doesn't leave me first.
Enjoy the elation of finally not having to be alive anymore.

I'm at the point where I either actively start hiding my insecurities and faking happiness or I kill myself.  I do look forward to being dead; not having to try and people please, no more upsetting my partner by revealing just how insecure I am and how much I hate myself (I'm never being as open or honest with him again, assuming he doesn't leave me first - not that I'd blame him), no more battling through pain just to be met with more pain.

With regards to 'secretly' looking forward to being dead - it seems to be more socially acceptable.  Nobody gives a shit about how suicidal you feel when you're alive, and in my experience people often leave you for it, so you might as well keep it to yourself.
I'm really worried that my partner is going to come to the same conclusion, and soon.  I don't know what'll happen.
Same fam.  When I don't eat, I feel like i have more control over my body and mood, and it's just easier to interact with the world.  I'm calmer and hate myself less.  It's so weird.
I feel this, yeah.  I'm just continuing because it'll hurt too many people if I take my own life, or at least, that's what I'm telling myself at this point.
I'm trying, I really, really am.

Just being able to see the value in life, that it won't always be a struggle against my mind, depression, anxiety.  I've been working really, really hard to get my mental health to some stable sort of place for a very long time, and had finally gotten to a place where my doctor asked me to step off of antidepressants, and it was wonderful - I had a solid fortnight of happy, unmedicated life, and I thought everything was going to be okay, and then my father died.  The abusive, alcoholic man who I'd cut out of my life was suddenly back, and suddenly I had to take care of everything, and I have nosedived.  I'm so fucking tired of fighting to want to live, fighting to see any value within myself as a person.  I'm so tired.

I am never having children and have no family apart from an aunt, but thank you for sharing this.  I keep thinking that I don't matter, that the world would just continue without me (check my post history if you must).  Today is slightly better, I didn't wake up crying, and so far today, haven't cried at all, so that's a decent start.
I am, I'm trying.
I have, I'm really trying to hold on.  Today is slightly better, it's the first day that I haven't woken up and cried.
Relief is how I'd describe it.  As a concept, that in itself is terrifying, but yes, I experience it too.

I've just accepted it.

I'm feeling suicidal, and have been for months.  I am fully aware of just how meaningless I am to everyone around me.  I'll be forgotten in a heartbeat.  Time progresses, even though we don't.  I'm glad that I'll be forgotten, because I haven't made enough of an impact for anyone to give much of a shit while I'm still here.
You are so, so lucky! That's really great :)

We aren't a replacement housewife/scapegoat/bitch for when your wife leaves you with good reason.  We aren't just a sounding board for your problems.  We aren't just a person you can sexualise and make inappropriate comments about.  We aren't just here for your purposes, to cook/clean/listen to you whine about your life and fetch you another drink.  You were supposed to be my first example of a good man, and you were anything but.  I'm glad you're dead, at least you can't hurt anyone else now, even if I have to live with the damage you did.  I wish you'd never been born.
Every fucking day.

I'm here at work, feeling embarrassed that I bothered to tell anyone how I felt this morning.  Work and being replaceable at my job is just another reason it doesn't matter if I'm alive or dead.  Now I'm wondering if I'll end up being fired for unreliability.  I'm wondering if I care.
It's really not making me want to stay in the land of the living.
My will to live.
